modified_files.source_note: Local porting test: pre-batch bytes retained; no upstream-file claim.

entry_contract: Persistent recovery applies only to Kafka _process_with_retry through a ContextVar and live writer; direct triage/build_state/replay keep their prior contracts.
identity_contract: Canonical UUID text for tenant/alert/workflow lookup, exact run identity and global-PK conflict validation; syntax is not alert ownership.
lookup_contract: Read completed first verdict/sources/artifact integrity before rules/governor/readers/model; unavailable, malformed and incomplete results fail closed, never become cache misses.
claim_contract: A committed unique running Run plus triage_started event at seq -1 is a processing reservation, not evidence of an actual model request. Running/unknown is not automatically reclaimed.
warm_recovery_contract: At most128 exact (run_id,tenant_id) slots retain deep state, five read receipts, exchanges, tier, usage/cost, original writer and post-groundedness projection; retry only the original record and return, without current reads/gates/effects.
first_result_contract: Versioned payload.recovery summary and first verdict/Run contents are protected; first claimed completion fills the original raw alert/summary/model, repeat completion does not rewrite Run, alert, usage or shadow decision.
legacy_contract: Old completed records are read-only legacy projections; absent historical fields remain explicitly unknown, and old receipts are not rewritten.
test_contract: Existing broker tests retain ledger failure assertions and explicitly stub only the new lookup/claim port. New worker integration and delivery SQL/claim tests are bounded offline doubles; real Kafka/PG are separate evidence.
scope_limits: No provider SDK retry/timeout/budget changes, model quality retest, automatic graph, approval or real response activation.
In-process result retention is bounded and not a durable model-response journal; an abandoned start remains unknown and stops automatic model retry.
Evidence-fingerprint dedup across different alerts remains separate from exact Run recovery.
No claim of exactly-once external model execution, universal wire-JSON validation or whole service admission.
